snippet.title: M.U.L.E. Online color vision deficiency enhancement
snippet.description:
This video demonstrates an in-progress enhancement in M.U.L.E. Online to address color vision deficiency.

M.U.L.E. Online uses a color scheme based on the classic Atari 8-bit computer version. Most would agree that it looks better than the Commodore 64 version. However, a fair number of people with color vision deficiency have mentioned that they have difficulty playing--to the point that it's not playable.

With Deuteranomaly and Protanomaly, in M.U.L.E., blue & purple plots are nearly indistinguishable from the other--and green & red plots are not that different either. The colors used in the Commodore 64 version have better contrast in this regard, but it's not perfect.

Inspired by the Commodore 64 version's player colors, this enhancement provides alternate player color palettes which use different shades to provide better contrast.
